One Pot Creamy French Onion Pasta! #onepotmeal #cooking #easyrecipe #recipes #pasta  3 large yellow onions 2 tbsp butter 1 tbsp vegetable oil 8 oz pancetta 2 garlic cloves 2 tbsp white wine 1 tsp salt 1/2 tsp thyme 1/2 tsp fresh rosemary 8-10 oz pasta 3 cups beef broth 1 cup heavy cream 1 cup fresh parmigiano regianno 1/2 cup fresh gruyère 

Transcript of the video's audio (machine-made):
Recipes that are better than takeout, episode 14. One pot creamy French onion pasta. Start by warming up your onions, slice and then add your pasta with some oil and butter. I'm gonna show you guys how to caramelize these in like 10-15 minutes. Let them get nice and brown on the bottom and then deglaze with a little bit of water. And again, just keep doing this so your onions are nice and caramelized. Add your pancetta, let it get nice and crispy and then add your garlic. Mix everything together and then deglaze with a touch of white wine, salt, a little bit of thyme, fresh rosemary, add in your dry pasta and your beef broth. Once you're about here, add your heavy cream and Parmesan. Then add a nice top layer of fresh creer. There's nothing better than...
